actions.name: multiattack
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} makes two attacks: one with its [[/item .qpUx52QbFUCSPSln]]{bite} and one with its [[/item .T8XMTiCIOQP4dYEp]]{claws}.

actions.name: bite
actions.desc: [[/attack extended]]. [[/damage extended]]. The target must succeed on a [[/save activity=ujb7xiAX4hUtM8fe]] saving throw or be &reference[poisoned] for [[lookup @labels.duration activity=ujb7xiAX4hUtM8fe]]. The creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

actions.name: spider climb
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

actions.name: web walker
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} ignores movement restrictions caused by webbing.

actions.name: web sense
actions.desc: While in contact with a web, the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} knows the exact location of any other creature in contact with the same web.

actions.name: web
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: [[/attack]], range 30/60 ft., one Large or smaller creature. Hit: The creature is &Reference[restrained] by webbing. As an action, the restrained target can make a [[/check activity=aELnqvc37WaAm0IG]] check, escaping from the webbing on a success. The effect ends if the webbing is destroyed. The webbing has AC 10, 5 hit points, is vulnerable to fire damage and immune to bludgeoning damage.
